test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• Difference between first letter and second letter position value according to English alphabetic series is (1).
 
• Difference between second letter and third letter position value according to English alphabetic series is (3).

So,

 
• Option - (1) : NOR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1123d12cff790ffa881802a6c237089e258e38ebb5ee79a459bcdfb3b3002fe9.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : LNP

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93c695772b0b5dafbd03403d16dda3c71447ff456573378c8b7633b4efa8b130.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : DEH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1494d248cbd8129b3cc50c3f35dbd14d13e79e768423dc904619ce313d17d9ff.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : LMP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbc2af1691b7a58d30594a8e2d202a44dafa9c5b79576a0761a1143ec197d26c.png] 

Thus, out of all options only 'LNP' doesn't follow the same logic as others.

​Hence, "DJP" is the correct answer.

90
